tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid tool of this server with what it returns, its parameters, its price in USD and an example. Payment is x402 (USDC on Base) per call; calls that fail or return no results are not charged.

tools.name: service_details
tools.description: Free. Returns the supported sites or stores, the extra filters and the output fields of one service, for example which supermarkets or job boards can be searched.

tools.name: grocery_nz_search
tools.description: Live prices from Woolworths New Zealand (formerly Countdown). Searches by keyword and returns products with price in NZD, was-price, unit price, specials, Club price flag, stock level, barcode and link. Suited to New Zealand grocery price and specials questions. $0.01 per call, up to 50 products.

tools.name: grocery_uk_search

Searches one store by keyword and returns products with price in GBP, was-price, unit price, promotion, pack size and link (Tesco and Asda prices come from the stores' own Google Shopping listings). Suited to UK grocery price
